Powell |asst_coach2 = Eric Wilson |asst_coach3 = Mantoris Robinson |stadium = [[TD Arena]] |champion = |tourney = |tourney_result = }} {{2019–20 CAA men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Charleston Cougars men's basketball team''' represented the [[College of Charleston]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Cougars, led by fifth-year head coach [[Earl Grant (basketball)|Earl Grant]], played their home games at the [[TD Arena]] in [[Charleston, South Carolina]] as members of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA). In a season limited due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the Cougars finished the season 9–10, 6–4 [[2020–21 Colonial Athletic Association men's basketball season|CAA play]], to finish in third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 CAA men's basketball tournament|CAA tournament]] to [[2020–21 Drexel Dragons men's basketball team|Drexel]].{{Cite web|title=Drexel vs. Charleston - Game Recap - March 7, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401301947|access-date=2021-12-14|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} Following the season, head coach Grant was hired as the new coach at [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College]].{{Cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=2021-03-15 |title=BC names Charleston's Grant new head coach |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31070629 |access-date=2021-12-15 |website=ESPN.com}} Shortly thereafter, the school named [[Winthrop Eagles men's basketball|Winthrop]] coach [[Pat Kelsey]] the team's new head coach.{{Cite web |last=Bilodeau |first=Kevin |date=March 25, 2021 |title=College of Charleston hiring Winthrop’s Pat Kelsey as new head basketball coach |url=https://www.live5news.com/2021/03/25/college-charleston-hiring-winthrops-pat-kelsey-new-head-basketball-coach |access-date=2021-12-15 |website=live5news.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=March 25, 2021 |title=Winthrop's Kelsey leaving for College of Charleston job |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2021/03/25/winthrops-kelsey-leaving-for-college-of-charleston-job/43481077/ |access-date=2021-12-15 |website=USA Today |language=en-US |agency=AP}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Charleston Cougars men's basketball team|Cougars]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 24–9, 12–6 in CAA play, to finish in third place in the conference.
